evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: 3D perception is shifting from task-specific pipelines to geometric foundation models: monocular depth networks, feed-forward 3D/4D reconstruction models, and vision--language models that predict geometry.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We present SpatialArena, an open arena that scores geometric models with the same metrics and rules, with robust and deterministic alignment.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: Evaluating 52 models, we find that single-image depth is close to saturation on public benchmarks but not on large, uncontrolled scenes, and that progress now comes from consistency across frames and views, where feed-forward 3D/4D models match or surpass monocular specialists and overtake video depth models.
